bootstrap_current_capabilities.truth: Collection attaches a stable locator and static seed before any runtime trace, fixture setup, final execution key, cache hit, or skip authority. Seed action is always RUN; authorizes_skip is always false; authorizes_lookup is always false. AutomaticItemIdentityAssembly@1 also returns action RUN and authorizes_skip false.

Cold-pass observation starts immediately before setup and stops after teardown without re-invoking the test body. Historical traces are never accepted as current. Authoritative execution-key assembly requires CurrentRuntimeTraceEvidence@1 from a fresh controlled preflight; missing or non-current evidence fails open to RUN.

Explicit injected lookup, store, candidate_store, provider, issuer, installer, resolver, and identity-service handles always win. Missing optional resolution degrades to RUN. Collection and lookup never prove.

Workers remain read/execute-only and return bounded public publication intents. The single controller deduplicates and invokes the fenced store entrypoint. Missing or stale coordination disables skips and writes; ordinary pytest execution remains. ControllerOwnedV2VerificationContext@1 may_authorize_skip is false and may_publish_candidate is false.
